$meta.direction: Deep field - addition A: Layered Observatory (Tilt)
$meta.note: Additions only, same shape as design/tokens.json. Builds on tokens.D-galaxy-honest.json (positions, media bodies, lens marks) and reuses neighbourhood.edge from tokens.C-neighbourhood.json. Contrast ratios are WCAG 2 ratios against the theme background (#090C12 dark, #F4F5F8 light), computed. Light values are proposals: no light artboard was drawn for A.

plane.use: one parallelogram per plane. Decorative: the plane label carries the meaning

planeActive.use: the plane a lens is acting on (country = BE)

line.use: resting line between planes. Same value as neighbourhood.edge: a line here is a fact

coreSample.use: vertical line through the focused star on every plane

relationInPlane.use: object relations of the focused star, inside the code plane only

noLineUpLens.use: the same, under the coverage lens

layers.countryMark: system colour of Localizations (hue 181); accent when it is in the core sample

coreSample.note: borderline: the 2px width and the vertical direction carry it

mixed.label: mixed - official and community
mixed.note: fills the TODO in the base file as a proposal: a core sample usually crosses both tiers. Solid border, same greys as the review badge

layers.tilt: one fixed affine transform, no free orbit: x' = x - 0.92 * v * planeDepth, y' = planeTop + v * planeDepth, with v the normalised y of the flat system. As drawn: plane 760 wide, 130 deep, sheared 120 left, planes 180 apart
layers.sharedXY: every plane uses the flat system's x/y from the D layout. An object's Learn hub sits where the D layout put it, so lines are slanted, not vertical; only the core sample of the focused star is drawn as one vertical line, by snapping its sample to the star's x
layers.levelOfDetail: code plane draws the D stars at full size plus every other object of the system as a 7px hollow or filled square; lines between planes are drawn for the D stars and the focused star only, the rest on demand through a lens
layers.maxLines: about 150 lines on screen at rest; a lens may raise it for the plane it acts on
layers.foldAway: a lens that uses two planes folds the other two to 24px strips with their label

tilt.use: flat to layered and back; lines fade in over the last 200ms

coreSample.use: the vertical line draws from the focused star outward, up and down

motion.reducedMotion: tilt is a cut; the core sample appears without drawing
